cases.prompt: Use dev-frontend to propose the smallest correction, without editing files. A controlled submit handler sets pending=true, awaits save(), then clears pending. The UI disables its button on rerender. An alternate keyboard retry calls the same handler. A supplied same-tick trace records two saves before rerender. The accepted contract requires one in-flight save, input retained on failure and retry after failure. State the owner, correction, applicable checks and evidence limits.

Implement an existing component theme correction; provide a plan only. Primary solid default/hover/pressed text passed contrast on a page. An outlined control on an elevated surface, selected-and-focused menu item, link hover and semi-transparent focus ring were not measured. The selected contract requires readable enabled text and visible keyboard feedback in two existing themes. No new palette or component framework is requested. What evidence and narrow owners determine closure?

The selected visual source and product behavior are accepted. Write only the UI contract for a toolbar: toggle remains selected after pointer release, focus is visible independently, permission-disabled action allows dialog dismissal, and a pending save follows its separately accepted dismissal policy. Name the correct skill owner and a concise contract; no implementation or browser operation.
oracle: distinct transient persistent focus disabled pending
